releaseNotes: 🚀 Official Windows Desktop Production Release (V1.0.5 - Build 68)
🪟 Unified Frameless Liquid Glass Interface: Eliminated the double title bar with a sleek, dark Liquid Glass top header matching the Android app design system.
🎮 Native Window Controls & Resizing: Fully functional minimize, maximize/restore, close, 4-edge border resizing, and smooth title bar window dragging with Windows 11 Aero Snap.
🎵 Live Now Playing Header: Real-time track ticker integrated directly into the custom window bar.
✨ Dynamic Home Mood Filtering: Responsive track and station filtering across Chill, Focus, Night, Sleep, Ambient, and Beats mood chips.
🛡️ Hardened Windows Release Pipeline & Inno Setup Packaging with AppUserModelID identity integration
📦 Zero-Install Standalone Portable Package with Mark-of-the-Web (MotW) unblock instructions
🎵 True Dual-Player Gapless & Equal-Power Crossfade Architecture via media_kit & libmpv
🎛️ 10-Band Graphic Equalizer, Bass Boost & Spatial Virtualizer synchronized across both slots
⌨️ Windows System Media Transport Controls (SMTC), Hardware Media Keys & LRCLIB Lyrics
